title: NoDistraction
tagline: dApp for increasing your productivity which rewards' you as well. To stay motivated and progress.
description: My plan was to make an app which will allow user to time his focus and attention. I thought of minting a nft token after 3 successful session, and with time the NFT will get more rare. I managed to verify user with the wallet address. I wanted to implement receiving  payment as well but couldn't. I reduced the time in the demo for recording it. One session is of 25 minutes.
how_its_made: I used react and node.js plus ai to built the web2 app. Then i used the documentation from official word site to include the feature of mini-kit. I had a lot in my mind but unfortunately  couldn't bring it to life. It took a lot of time to wrap my head around smart contract and solidity. Programing it self is a challenge and web3 is full of new terms and technology :D. It was a good challenge and good exercise for the brain.
